g.text: OCI k3s + GitOps — Dashboard, Domain, Access & Backup Flow
Cloudflare Tunnel is outbound-only. No A record to the VM, ports 80/443/6443 closed, no load balancer (no MetalLB / ServiceLB / OCI LB).
1. One-time setup — create the Access gate before any hostname goes live
2. Public request path — TLS + login at Cloudflare edge, tunnel to Traefik, Host routing to apps
no A record to the VM
New app = one Ingress with gethomepage.dev annotations → new card.
No DNS, tunnel, or load balancer change per app.
No MetalLB / ServiceLB / OCI LB: cloudflared dials out,
Argo CD stays private (kubectl port-forward over SSH, or Tailscale)
until the Phase 3 Access gate exists; later argocd.example.com behind Access.
Argo CD watches Git, not registries:
OCI backups must be explicitly configured with a backup policy; they are not automatic for every volume.
